U_0x00335D: A bio-weapon of the <Einst> series, piloted by Alfimi. An <Einst> optimized to fight <Personal Trooper>s, it boasts high mobility, defense, and solo teleportation. Its frame mixes a hard yet pliant skeleton and skin with soft muscle-fiber parts. It wields the Oni Renge sword and Oni Bosatsu cannon in tricky paired attacks.
U_0x0035DD: VA mass-production <Personal Trooper> based on the Huckebein Mk-II, adopted as the new mainline unit of the <Earth Fed Army>'s "Aegis Plan" buildup. A standard <Tesla Drive> allows solo flight under gravity. It lacks <EOT>-derived weaponry, but its base performance nearly matches the prototype's, and its improved Gespenst-line GII frame keeps production costs low.
U_0x0038CD:
A unit hastily assembled from the wrecked <Personal Trooper> "Exbein" and its spare parts. "Ashe" was its development codename; the official name is "Exbein Ashe". The name is the French reading of "H" (ache), the initial of "Huckebein", and also means "ash", after the phoenix that rises from the ashes.
The Exbein was to be refitted as a data-gathering test unit for a new Huckebein-series machine, but was wrecked by a mysterious unit's attack. Fitted with emergency "Patch Armor" and the anti-beam "Coating Cloak" mantle, it was thrown into combat. Even then work was unfinished - some armor is held on with flexible "AD Tape" - a true stopgap.
It also carries the <T-LINK System> (a telekinesis sensing amplifier), which reacted abnormally when Ing boarded; since then only he can pilot the Ashe.
U_0x003ED4: A bombardment AM part for the Huckebein Mk-III. A manned <Personal Trooper> carrier, also usable alone, mounting four G-Impact Cannons and missiles.
U_0x00401A:
A super <Personal Trooper> built from the Exbein Ashe. The culmination of the Huckebein series, it uses technology from the Huckebein Mk-III's development and the RXR Project. "Exexbein" derives from "EX Exbein", but as the sixth Huckebein - after the Huckebein, Huckebein EX (Exbein), Mk-II, mass-production Mk-II, and Mk-III - it also evokes "sechs", German for six. Its dev codenames were "Mk-X" and "Double EX".
An ultra-high-performance unit able to run a <Tronium> engine and a black hole engine together, it wields telekinetic weapons such as the "T-LINK Slider".
